support.notes: Exact Steam pin of the public head at declaration time (buildid 25730807, Valheim 1.0.17 network version 40, updated 2026-10-06). Repins the previous 1.0.16/25527701 target after Valve moved the public branch (#382); depot 896661 manifest 3707659388211752971. The connector is a dedicated-server plugin. An optional graphical-client inventory mod (role client-companion) exists; deploy only parks its zip in takaro-companion/. Player-driven events (chat, deaths, kills), server chat and the optional inventory mod need a connected game client and are NOT covered by takaro-maint verify, which boots a dedicated server with no client. Runtime CI onboarding is a separate issue.
